what: Example: Calculating the Gender Participation Gap
title: Exploring Global Labor Force Participation Gaps by Gender and Marital Status
text: package exports calc_labor_gap() summarize male versus female participation rates calculate gender gap (percentage points) across marital status categories:

what: Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
title: Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
text: curated dataset derived International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) database (Indicator: EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_MTS_RT_A). Contains annual labor force participation rates percent across countries, broken sex, aggregate age groups, aggregate marital status categories 2015.

title: Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
text: tibble 8 variables: country Character. Country territory name. survey_source Character. Name underlying national household survey census. sex Character. Sex category ("Male", "Female", ""). age_group Character. Aggregate age band (e.g., "15–24", "25–54", "55–64"). Note: '15+' represents total aggregate working-age population. marital_status Character. Aggregated marital status ("Married / Union / Cohabiting", "Single / Widowed / Divorced"). year Numeric. Calendar year observation. participation_rate Numeric. Labour force participation rate percent. data_status Character. Data quality flag status (e.g., "Break series", NA).

title: Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
text: International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) database: Indicator EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_MTS_RT_A: https://ilostat.ilo.org/

title: Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status — labor_force_marital
text: raw ILOSTAT dataset cleaned follows: Filtered non-missing participation rates excluded records flagged "Unreliable". Records flagged "Break series" (methodological updates national household surveys) retained preserve longitudinal continuity. Retained aggregate age bands aggregate marital status categories. Removed non-specific aggregate categories including "Total" (sex marital status) "elsewhere classified". Stripped category label prefixes (e.g., "Age (Aggregate bands): ") cleaner visual plotting.
